subject: Patch audit trace, CVE closure timeline & evidence export
messages:
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@freeflowhealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: security@freeflowhealth.com
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: patch audit trace + CVE remediation evidence (FFH SOC2)

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for taking this. Our SOC2 audit vendor has asked for a consolidated export showing the last two weeks of vulnerability scanning results for the Redwood-hosted services we use, plus an audit trace that links each critical/high CVE to an owner, remediation PR, and verification scan. Specifically they want:

- consolidated scan exports (raw and summarized) for 2027-04-15 -> 2027-04-29
- a simple CSV mapping: CVE -> owner (team member) -> remediation PR/CL -> verification scan timestamp
- SLAs you operate against for CVE triage and remediation (what you promise for critical/high)
- one-page attestation that CVE closure evidence is retained for 12 months and how to access it

Can you confirm whether this can be produced by EOD Monday (May 3)? If you can, please provide the files and a short statement we can pass to the auditor.

Best,
Sarah
Security Operations
FreeFlow Health

Attachment: sample-audit-template.xlsx (their template)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@freeflowhealth.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: patch audit trace + CVE remediation evidence (FFH SOC2)

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear checklist. We can provide the exports and a short attestation. Plan below:

1) Deliverables (by COB Mon, May 3):
   - scan-export-20270428.json (raw scanner output) and a summary CSV
   - patch-log-20270429.csv: CVE -> owner -> PR/CL -> verification-scan-timestamp
   - SLA statement (critical: 72 hours triage + 14 day remediation target; high: 7 day triage + 30 day remediation target)
   - one-page attestation PDF confirming retention and access process

2) Owners: Markus will lead assembly of the patch log and verification checks; Laura will prepare the attestation language; I will export scanner results and run the final spot-checks.

3) Access: We will upload artifacts to a shared Drive folder and provide a read-only link plus internal record ID for traceability.

I’m attaching the raw scan export and the preliminary patch log. Markus/Laura — please review and add any missing links or corrections.

Thanks,
Monica
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: scan-export-20270428.json, patch-log-20270429.csv
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@freeflowhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 08:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: patch audit trace + CVE remediation evidence (FFH SOC2)

On Fri, Apr 30, 2027 at 11:05 AM Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com> wrote:
> I’m attaching the raw scan export and the preliminary patch log. Markus/Laura — please review and add any missing links or corrections.

Thanks — I looked through the patch-log and added PR links for three outstanding high/CVEs we remediated during the last window. Summary of actions I appended to the CSV:

- CVE-2027-31415 -> owner: runtime-team/rohan -> PR#3221 -> verification scan 2027-04-29T22:04:12Z
- CVE-2027-31111 -> owner: infra-team/karthik -> PR#3250 -> verification scan 2027-04-29T22:07:50Z
- CVE-2027-30777 -> owner: deps-team/maya -> PR#3198 -> verification scan 2027-04-28T04:12:11Z

I also verified the scanning system picked up the verification runs; I flagged two late verifications that were run outside of our 30-day target and added a short note in the CSV explaining the variance.

If Sarah needs the raw PR diffs we can include a ZIP, but typically auditors accept the PR links and timestamps.

— Markus
Principal Engineer, Security Tools
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@freeflowhealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: patch audit trace + CVE remediation evidence (FFH SOC2)

Hi Sarah,

Attached is the requested one-page attestation and the finalized export files uploaded to the Drive link Monica mentioned. Summary statement below for the auditor:

- Redwood Inference confirms that vulnerability scan exports for 2027-04-15 through 2027-04-29 have been provided (scan-export-20270428.json and summary CSV).
- The attached patch-log-20270429.csv maps each CVE to an internal owner, the remediation PR/CL, and the verification scan timestamp.
- Remediation SLAs: critical CVEs are triaged within 72 hours and targeted for remediation within 14 calendar days; high CVEs are triaged within 7 days and targeted for remediation within 30 calendar days. Deviations, when they occur, are tracked with remediation notes in the patch log.
- Evidence retention: CVE remediation artifacts (scan exports, PR links, verification run logs, and attestations) are retained in our internal records for at least 12 months from closure. Access is via the provided Drive link and is traceable via internal record ID FFH-12345.

We’ve attached the signed attestation PDF (cve-closure-attestation-FFH-20270503.pdf). Please let us know if the auditor needs additional raw diffs or a packaged ZIP of PRs.

Best regards,
Laura Bennett
Director, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: cve-closure-attestation-FFH-20270503.pdf
